_comment: M08 rucks (Rugby 08 style). Metres, seconds, kg. Contest: P(turnover) = clamp(logistic(contest_bias + contest_slope * x)), x = defence units - attack units (+ jackal_bonus if a defender bound first). One body ~ 1 unit. Calibrated: equal numbers ~8 %, one defender more ~27 %, isolated carrier vs. one jackal ~55 %, 4 v 1 ~90 % (p_max). Only bodies bound within contest_time count.
